advisories.title: Django SQL injection via key and index lookups in JSONField/HStoreField
advisories.description: Django before 2.2.4 allows SQL injection via key and index lookups for JSONField/HStoreField on PostgreSQL.

advisories.title: Django ReDoS via truncation of very long text
advisories.description: Django before 2.2.4 is susceptible to ReDoS (regular expression denial of service) in django.utils.text.Truncator.

advisories.title: requests sends HTTP authorization credentials to redirect targets
advisories.description: The requests library before 2.20.0 sends HTTP authorization credentials to a redirect target, potentially leaking secrets to third parties.

advisories.title: PyYAML arbitrary code execution via yaml.load() without Loader
advisories.description: PyYAML before 5.3.1 allows arbitrary code execution when yaml.load() is called without an explicit Loader argument.

advisories.title: urllib3 improper certificate validation when CA certificates not provided
advisories.description: urllib3 before 1.24.2 does not validate SSL certificates correctly when a CA bundle is not provided, allowing for man-in-the-middle attacks.

advisories.title: urllib3 CRLF injection via request parameter
advisories.description: urllib3 before 1.24.3 is vulnerable to CRLF injection via the request parameter, enabling header injection attacks.

advisories.title: Jinja2 sandbox escape via str.format_map
advisories.description: Jinja2 before 2.10.1 allows sandbox escape via the str.format_map method in a crafted template.

advisories.title: cryptography Bleichenbacher timing oracle vulnerability in RSA decryption
advisories.description: The cryptography package before 3.2 is vulnerable to Bleichenbacher timing oracle attacks against RSA decryption, potentially allowing key recovery.

advisories.title: paramiko authentication bypass via crafted SSH message
advisories.description: paramiko before 2.4.2 allows authenticated SSH clients to bypass authorization controls via a crafted packet, enabling privilege escalation.
